steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own Xbox360 ISO or extracted folder containing default.xex and databigs; only original port-specific disc revision accepted. Exact region/media/fingerprint not in reviewed README or BUILDING.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
